name: MVP 28.3 – Maintenance Center Restructure
description: Restructures the Maintenance Center into a grouped, safer and more intuitive administration surface while preserving the chat-first user GUI.
features: New read-only MaintenanceCenterService as central maintenance information architecture
Grouped /maintenance page for overview, decisions, knowledge, capabilities, configuration and learning/review
Risk labels for read-only, approval, controlled write, activation, configuration and manual run areas
New CLI commands maintenance-center-status and maintenance-center-contract
User GUI remains chat-first with exactly one Maintenance entry point
safety: Human approval remains required for risk actions
